scripts.check:pi: node --input-type=module -e "import { existsSync } from 'node:fs'; if (!existsSync('pi/node_modules')) { console.error('Missing pi/node_modules. Run npm run install:pi once.'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build:pi: npm run check:pi && npm --prefix ./pi run build --workspace=@earendil-works/pi-telemetry && npm --prefix ./pi run build:offline --workspace=@earendil-works/pi-ai && npm --prefix ./pi run build --workspace=@earendil-works/pi-agent-core
scripts.build:web: esbuild web/client.ts web/settings.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outdir=web/dist --entry-names=[name] && npm run build:live2d
scripts.build: npm run build:pi && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:pi && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p Live2D/tsconfig.json
scripts.dev: npm run build:pi && npm run build:web && tsx watch src/index.ts
